Summary:

Villa del Mar



The Space:

Discover the sublime beauty of the Emerald Coast from this luxe, coastal villa! Ideally situated in the gated, Seagrove Beach community of Palmeira Villas, this gorgeous four-bedroom offers three levels of high-end features and amenities, providing the perfect home base for exploring the area. Enjoy easy access to gulf beaches, local seafood, shopping, and walking distance to coastal dune lake, Eastern Lake, and hiking trails in Point Washington State Forest. Public beach access at One Seagrove Place is just a short walk from the villa. The resort community of Seaside is just two miles down Highway 30A.



The gorgeous interior is tastefully furnished with contemporary elegance, featuring a cheery, coastal motif throughout. Designed with group gathering in mind, the main floor living area boasts a spacious, open layout equipped for guest comfort and convenience. Sprawl out on the wraparound sofa in the living room while chatting with friends and family or stream your shows on the smart TV, equipped with Apple TV. Store your favorite bottle of wine in the wet bar's beverage fridge and enjoy a chilled glass later during happy hour. Those culinary-minded in the group will find the kitchen well-appointed for home-cooking, featuring a deluxe array of stainless steel appliances including a five-burner gas range and vent with pot-filler faucet, deep-basin sink, and dishwasher. An island prep station doubles as a breakfast bar with seating for four. Sit down for family-style meals at the dining table set for eight. A full bathroom is located on the ground floor for household convenience.



Three bedrooms and the laundry room can be found on the second floor. A children's bunk room and a guest room with access to a private balcony share a full bathroom (with en suite access from each). The primary bedroom on this level includes an attached, full bathroom.



The third-floor primary suite includes a smart TV equipped with Apple TV and an attached, full bathroom complete with a soaking tub and standalone shower. A mini bar equipped with a beverage fridge and Keurig coffee maker is located just outside the door for easy convenience.



Make the most of Florida's famous sunshine and blue skies while relaxing on the furnished back patio. Fire up the gas grill for a seaside barbecue and watch the stars come out while gathered around the wood-burning firepit. Take the bikes out for a spin around the neighborhood or pedal over to one of the great, nearby restaurants to sample the local fare.



THINGS TO KNOW

Adult bikes are provided.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

responses.response: Thank you for your feedback, Kiera. We're glad you enjoyed our beautiful home overall. We’re sorry the sandy floors and the unexpected beach access closure impacted your stay. The boardwalk construction was out of our control, and we apologize for the lack of prior notice. We appreciate you sharing this and hope to welcome you back for a smoother visit.

reviews.text: The home was beautiful and overall we really enjoyed the house. The two major downfalls though were that the floors were all sandy throughout the home, and the beach access advertised was closed which messed up all of our beach rentals. The closure of the beach access was also not communicated prior to us at all.
reviews.title: Beautiful home but needed to be cleaned more

reviews.author: Kelly T.
reviews.label: Excellent

responses.response: Kelly, thank you for sharing your experience with us, we're pleased that you loved our home and that it was a perfect fit for your getaway! We appreciate your bringing some items to our attention and our local manager assured us that maintenance has caulked the shower. We enjoyed having you as our guest and we hope to host you again.

reviews.text: This was our first time staying in this side of 30a. I was super worried about beach convenience but it was super easy. House was beautiful and comfortable for our family of 4. Would definitely recommend and stay again. It was a bonus that Apple TV & streaming services were available, not every house has access to these. My only complaint would be the master shower needs some work, moldy caulking needs replaced. Other than that, house was clean and perfect.

reviews.author: Jay H.
reviews.label: Good
reviews.text: Very nice house in an excellent location. However, I will say the 30A HWY was very busy while we were there, which makes pulling out in traffic on the golf cart a little scary. BTW, the golf cart that came with the house was a lot of fun for all of us, especially for the younger ones. Our only complaint was the house smelled like cigarette smoke, even when we got home our clothes and suitcases reeked of it. We were given a small air purifier when we complained about it, which seemed to help somewhat. Overall we really enjoyed our stay here.

responses.response: We sincerely apologize for any disconnect in the care you received when communicating with our team, Damien and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention. We welcome your feedback as a means to improve and will be sure to follow up with the appropriate parties regarding your experience.

reviews.text:
The house is gorgeous, clean, perfectly located with close beach access, and the golf cart made it easy to transport stuff and people to the beach. Chairs and umbrellas are also available which is convenient. 

However, if you plan on cooking, bring your kitchen with you. 2 small pots, no frying pan, no good knife, no cutting board, no bakeware. We were a family of 10 including 4 children, and getting food ready was simply a struggle. We contacted Vacasa but never heard back, for the price we were disappointed and expected more on that standpoint.

Overall a great vacation, but a well furnished kitchen would have made a big difference.
